errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Länder dar, die alphabetisch von Polen bis Spanien geordnet sind
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents '% des BIP', not countries. The vertical axis lists countries.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse stellt den prozentualen Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024 dar
errors.evidence: The vertical axis lists countries, not the percentage increase. The description incorrectly swaps the axes.

errors.text_span: Jeder Nation ist ein horizontaler Balken zugeordnet, dessen Farbe ein dunkleres Blau ist
errors.evidence: Each bar consists of two segments: blue (increase 2021-2024) and green (2021 expenditures). The description ignores the green segment.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ... ist von 0 bis 4,5 % skaliert
errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is from 0 to 4%, not 4.5%.
The longest bar belongs to Poland, not Iceland, which is not even listed in the figure.
Poland's total bar length is approximately 3.5%, not 4.3%.

errors.text_span: Luxemburg mit einem Anstieg von etwa 1,3 %
errors.evidence: Luxembourg's blue segment (increase) is closer to 0.5%, not 1.3%. The description also misrepresents the segment as the entire bar.
The description does not state that the chart illustrates government expenditures as a percentage of GDP.
The description omits the green segment representing 2021 expenditures.
The description omits the black line indicating 1.5% above the 2021 reference value.
The description does not mention that each bar consists of two stacked segments.
The description does not mention the legend explaining the color coding.
Iceland is not listed in the figure or atom checklist.
The bars are not hatched; this visual feature does not exist in the figure.
The description introduces subjective interpretation not supported by the figure or atoms.

errors.text_span: Die restlichen Länder zeigen Anstiege in verschiedenen Größenordnungen zwischen diesen Extremwerten
errors.evidence: Vague reference to 'restlichen Länder' without specifying which countries or values are included.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Länder dar, die alphabetisch von Polen bis Spanien geordnet sind
errors.evidence: Awkward phrasing; the horizontal axis does not represent countries, and the vertical axis is already ordered.
